title: Tech & architecture slides for the UPM deck

slides.title: Models reach SAP through one tested pipeline pattern, not fragile one-off scripts
bullets: Every production model uses the same template: features from Snowflake + dbt, training and registry in Databricks, scored output written back to SAP S/4HANA through a staged, reconciled interface.
No release in the days around quarterly close.

diagram.band: Run cost capped per pipeline and reported monthly, so compute spend cannot drift past the estimate

slides.title: A pipeline goes to production only when it passes the same checklist
table: Data contract + dbt tests on inputs
Upstream changes fail loudly, not at quarter close
Model registry approval by your owner
No model reaches SAP without a named sign-off
Monitoring and alert to the owner
A failing pipeline is fixed the same day
Rollback to the previous model version
Business continues if a release misbehaves
Cost cap and monthly cost report
Spend stays inside the department estimate
slides.note: Snowflake + dbt is the best fit for Recordly's Virtual Data Engineer (see team/vde); offer it only as the variant Ville prepared.
